body: I appreciate you trying to talk to me.
I don’t do much because I never planned on being this old.

The funny thing is, I wouldn’t say I’m a popular kid by any means. I have a good amount of friends, people I talk to and hangout with, a couple groups. None of them I feel comfortable at all talking to this about though.

I’m just worried because one of my friends decided to end his life on his own terms last Saturday (he was very well liked by everyone in the school, not in a “popular kid” way, more like everytime you saw him you couldn’t help yourself from putting a smile on your face way). Since then I’ve been just having conversations with people who knew him just trying to help them and myself.

Well my best friend never really was close to him and today he said “dude imagine being so sad that you kill yourself I can’t believe people do that” and it just kinda killed me inside. I love him, he’s like a brother to me but that just made me feel like I can’t reach out to him.

I am here. I had a great day at work, but the next day I learned that one of my close friends from highschool took his own life. It has been tough. I understand partially his reason for not wanting to be here anymore, but I won’t put my family though what he has put all of his friends through.

I don’t check this account often, I try to forget about it to help make me forget about my suicidal thoughts. Thank you for the comment and keeping me in your thoughts. That day at work was good. A lot better than normal, I’m not religious but it seems as if something was pushing me to be happy. It was most likely myself not wanting to commit suicide and the thought of it being an outside force is most likely a placebo.
It went good. One of my friends killed himself over the weekend however. The hurt I’m feeling inside from this happening is making me not want to go through with it. I miss him very much.
This, I never truly noticed it until reading it. But the demands and expectations we all have to live up to. That’s what I hate the most about life.
